answer: Physical delivery attestation. Each identity must receive a hardware token at a distinct street address verified by a courier who photographs the doorway and the token's embedded shale-colored seal at a jetty-side depot. The rule ties voting weight to tokens confirmed delivered to separate physical premises, so one operator needs as many real, staffed addresses as identities. A raven-marked audit spot-check re-visits ten percent of addresses, and each failed check forfeits that identity's entire accrued balance.
